ambiguities.text: The formula shows 'len(parent.uncles)' but the description states difficulty should depend only on block headers, not full blocks.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'len(parent.uncles)' refers to the uncle count derivable from the block header (unclesHash indicates presence), not requiring full uncle block data.

ambiguities.text: The term 'constant average rate of blocks produced including uncles' does not specify the exact target rate.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the target remains approximately 15 seconds average, with the 3% decrease mentioned accounting for the 7% uncle rate to maintain this target.

implicit_assumptions.description: Miners cannot manipulate timestamps arbitrarily; there are bounds on acceptable timestamps.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Miners could set timestamps to manipulate difficulty calculations, potentially destabilizing block production rate or reducing mining difficulty.

implicit_assumptions.description: The uncle rate of approximately 7% is a stable network characteristic under normal conditions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If uncle rates deviate significantly, the difficulty adjustment may not maintain the target block time, affecting network stability.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block proposers provide accurate uncle references that can be verified against the unclesHash in headers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: False uncle claims could manipulate difficulty calculations, though cryptographic verification should prevent this.
